_comment: PHARMACY StoreProfile — the agnostic proof. Same shape as electronics.json, totally different flavour. As each electronics flavour slot is excised from the core into a profile read, this profile proves the core stays agnostic: a pharmacy query must NOT inherit laptop brands, GPU specs, or laptop price bands. Today only brand_price_floors + nqe_brand_detect are profile-backed; this profile grows as R2/R3 excise more slots. A high-stakes/regulated vertical is the right proof because the control/evidence moat (claim-guard, policy gate, audit) matters most here.
_manufacturers_comment: Agnostic proof: the SAME 3-axis schema (manufacturer / product line / vs type) with pharmacy flavour and zero laptop/GPU tokens. Lines are product ranges (Panadol Osteo, Swisse Ultiboost).
_product_type_rules_comment: Agnostic proof: the SAME mechanism (product_classifier) classifies pharmacy products from THIS profile — zero laptop/GPU flavour. Ordered, first-match-wins, specific before primary.

product_type_rules.pattern: \b(thermometer|blood pressure monitor|bp monitor|nebuli[sz]er|glucose|pulse oxim|inhaler device|hot water bottle|heat pack)\b

_regulatory_comment: Pharmacy is WHY the control moat matters: dosage/age/schedule are POLICY, not recommendation. These belong in the merchant policy + execution gate, not the recommender.
